ja515:1.1: Rajjañ ca paṭipann' asmā adhipacca. Sucīrata, mahattaṃ pattum icchāmi vijetuṃ paṭhaviṃ imaṃ
ja515:2.1: Dhammena no adhammena, adhammo me na ruccati, kicco va dhammo carito rañño hoti Sucīrata,
ja515:3.1: Idha c' evāninditā yena pecca yena aninditā Yasaṃ devamanussesu yena pappomu brāhmaṇa.
ja515:4.1: Yo 'ham atthañ ca dhammañ ca kattum icchāmi brāhmaṇa taṃ tvaṃ atthaṃ ca dhammañ ca brāhmaṇ' akkhāhi pucchito ti.
ja515:5.1: Nāññatra Vidhurā rāja etad akkhātum arahati yaṃ tvaṃ atthañ ca dhammañ ca kattum icchasi khattiyā 'ti g. ā.
ja515:6.1: Ehi kho pahito gaccha Vidhurassa upantikaṃ, nikkham imaṃ suvaṇṇassa haraṃ gaccha Sucīrata, abhihāraṃ imaṃ dajjā atthadhammānusatthiyā ti g. ā.
ja515:7.1: Sv-ādhippāgā Bhāradvājo Vidhurassa upantikaṃ. tam addasa mahābrahmā asamānaṃ sake ghare ti.
ja515:8.1: Rañño 'haṃ pahito dūto Korabyassa yasassino, ‘atthaṃ dhammañ ca pucchesi' icc-abravi Yudhiṭṭhilo, taṃ tvaṃ atthañ ca dhammañ ca Vidhur' akkhāhi pucchito ti.
ja515:9.1: Gaṃgaṃ me pidahissanti, na naṃ sakkomi brāhmaṇa apidhetuṃ mahāsindhuṃ, taṃ kathaṃ so bhavissati, na te sakkomi akkhātuṃ atthaṃ dhammaṃ ca pucchito ti.
ja515:10.1: Bhadrakāro ca me putto oraso mama atrajo, taṃ tvaṃ atthañ ca dhammañ ca gantvā pucchassu brāhmaṇā 'ti.
ja515:11.1: Sv-ādhippāgā Bhāradvājo Bhadrakārass' upantikaṃ, tam addasa mahābrahmā nisinnaṃ samhi vesmanīti.
ja515:12.1: Rañño 'haṃ pahito dūto Koravyassa yasassino, ‘atthaṃ dhammañ ca pucchesi' icc-abravi Yudhiṭṭhilo, taṃ tvaṃ atthañ ca dhammañ ca Bhadrakāra brāvīhi me ti.
ja515:13.1: Maṃsakācaṃ avahāya godhaṃ anupatām' ahaṃ, na te sakkomi akkhātuṃ atthaṃ dhammañ ca pucchito.
ja515:14.1: Sañjayo nāma me bhātā kaniṭṭho me Sucīrata, taṃ tvaṃ atthañ ca dhammañ ca gantvā pucchassu brāhmaṇā 'ti.
ja515:15.1: Sv-adhippāgā Bhāradvājo Sañjayassa upantikaṃ, tam addassa mahābrāhmā nisinnaṃ sa [mhi] parīsati.
ja515:16.1: Rañño 'haṃ pahito dūto Koravyassa yasassino, ‘atthaṃ dhammañ ca pucchesi' icc-abravi Yudhiṭṭhilo. taṃ tvaṃ atthañ ca dhammañ ca Sañjay' akkhāhi pucchito ti.
ja515:17.1: Sadā maṃ gilati maccu sāyaṃ pāto Sucīrata, na te sakkomi akkhātuṃ atthaṃ dhammañ ca pucchito.
ja515:18.1: Sambhavo nāma me bhātā kaniṭṭho me Sucīrato. taṃ tvaṃ atthañ ca dhammañ ca gantvā pucchassu brāhmaṇā 'ti.
ja515:19.1: Abbhuto vata bho dhammo, nāyaṃ asmāka ruccati, tayo janā pitā puttā te su paññāya no vidu.
ja515:20.1: Na taṃ sakkotha akkhātuṃ atthaṃ dhammañ ca pucchitā, kathan nu daharo jaññā atthaṃ dhammañ ca pucchito ti.
ja515:21.1: Mā naṃ daharo [ti] uññāsi apucchitvāna Sambhavaṃ, pucchitvā Sambhavaṃ jaññā atthaṃ dhammañ ca brāhmaṇa.
ja515:22.1: Yathāpi cando vimalo gacchaṃ {ākāsadhātuyā} sabbe tārāgaṇe loke ābhāya atirocati
ja515:23.1: Evam pi dahar' ūpeto paññāyogena Sambhavo, mā naṃ daharo [ti] uññāsi apucchitvāna Sambhavaṃ, pucchitvā Sambhavaṃ jaññā athaṃ dhammañ ca brāhmaṇa.
ja515:24.1: Yathāpi rammako māso gimhānaṃ hoti brāhmaṇa at' ev' aññehi māsehi dumapupphehi sobhati Evam pi dahar' ūpeto --pe--.
ja515:26.1: Yathāpi himavā brahme pabbato Gandhamādano nānārukkhehi sañchanno mahābhūtagaṇālayo osadhehi ca dibbehi disā bhāti pavāti ca
ja515:28.1: Yathāpi pāvako brahme accimālī yasassimā jalamāno caraṃ kacchi analo kaṇhavattanī
ja515:29.1: Ghatāsano dhumaketu uttamāhevanandaho nisīthe pabbataggasmiṃ pahūtedho virocati Evam pi dahar' ūpeto --pe--.
ja515:31.1: Javena bhadraṃ jānanti balivaddañ ca vāhiye dohena dhenuṃ jānanti bhāsamānañ ca paṇḍitaṃ,
ja515:32.1: Evam pi dahar' ūpeto paññāyogena Sambhavo, mā naṃ daharo [ti] uññāsi apucchitvāna Sambhavaṃ, pucchitvā Sambhavaṃ jaññā atthaṃ dhammañ ca brāhmaṇā 'ti.
ja515:33.1: Sv-ādhippāgā Bhāradvājo Sambhavassa upantikaṃ, tam addasa mahābrahmā kīḷamānaṃ bahī pure ti g. ā.
ja515:34.1: Rañño 'haṃ pahito dūto Koravyassa yasassino, ‘atthaṃ dhammañ ca pucchassu' icc-abravi Yudhiṭṭhilo, taṃ tvaṃ atthañ ca dhammañ ca Sambhav' akkhāhi pucchito
ja515:35.1: ti Taggha te aham akkhissaṃ yathāpi kusalo tathā,(=Sumaṅgala I 156,1) rājā ca kho naṃ jānāti yadi kāhati vā na vā ti g. ā.
ja515:36.1: Ajja suve ti saṃseyya raññā puṭṭho Sucīrata mā katvā avasī rājā atthe jāte Yudhiṭṭhilo.
ja515:37.1: Ajjhattaṃ ñeva saṃseyya raññā puṭṭho Sucīrata, kummaggaṃ na niveseyya yathā mūḷho acetaso.
ja515:38.1: Attānaṃ nātivatteyya, adhammaṃ na samācare, atitthe na-ppātareyya, anatthe na yuto siyā.
ja515:39.1: Yo ca etāni ṭhānāni kattuṃ jānāti khattiyo sadā so vaḍḍhate rājā sukkapakkhe va candimā.
ja515:40.1: Ñatīnañ ca piyo hoti mittesu ca virocati, kāyassa bhedā sappañño saggaṃ so upapajjātīti
